title: Blue Sky Studios
content: Yesterday Jeanette and I kicked off the Road Tour with a visit to Blue Sky Studios in White Plains, New York. Blue Sky created the CG animated featuresIce AgeandRobots. I presented the behind-the-scenes PowerPoint show about the making ofJourney to Chandarato a group of their designers, animators, and directors.Everyone at Blue Sky is informal and friendly and very enthusiastic about what they do. Check out the studio’swebsite, which describes their filmmakingprocessandwhat it’s liketo work there. We were so impressed with the level of talent there, in so many departments— character design, story, layout, color scripting, effects, and lighting.They’re currently deep in production on Dr. Seuss’sHorton Hears a Whofor a March 14, 2008 release. The designers showed great respect for the style and spirit of the original book. It promises to be the best Seuss adaptation yet.
